title: Reverse String
summary: You get a list of characters `s`. Reverse it in place, using only a constant amount of extra memory.
constraints: change the list itself instead of returning a new one

approaches.twist: Swap the two ends and move both pointers inward.

signals.meaning: No copy: swap elements from both ends.
Only a couple of indexes are allowed.

constraintReading: Up to 10⁵ characters allows O(n); the O(1) memory rule rules out building a reversed copy.
